title: Does map inconsistency change what a stroke model trusts?
question: In a held-out ISLES'24 multichannel infarct surrogate, does experimentally increasing the local central-volume residual attenuate response to an identity-consistent perfusion worsening at the same site?
rung: Target rung 1: functional residual-dependent modulation in one frozen surrogate on realism-gated support; rung 2 requires replication across model families and independently regenerated maps.
deliverable_original: The final-infarct model is using violation of the central-volume identity as a hidden confidence map for perfusion evidence.
deliverable_sentence: On tested ISLES'24 support, a frozen multichannel infarct surrogate responds less to the same identity-consistent perfusion worsening when the local central-volume residual is experimentally set higher.
X_measurement: Within valid common brain support, compute signed r = log(CBV) - log(CBF) - log(MTT/60) - k_case, where k_case is fitted on declared normal contralateral tissue, and X = |r|. Freeze units, laterality source, background, clipping, and support rules after the array audit and before model inference.
suspected_signal: A multichannel predictor may functionally use disagreement among CBF, CBV, and MTT as a warning that perfusion evidence is unreliable. The experiment tests the observable interaction only, not explicit internal computation of r or calibrated uncertainty.
use_vs_association: At each eligible held-out site, cross a low versus high same-sign r set-point with absent versus present identity-consistent worsening. The worsening lowers CBF and compensates through a different channel so signed r is unchanged. Arm A sets r through CBV and compensates through MTT; arm B sets r through MTT and compensates through CBV. The primary within-site difference-in-differences must agree across arms and residual-sign strata after a frozen compensator-only sham adjustment.
keystone_prerequisite: Released CBF, CBV, and MTT arrays have commensurate scales and common valid support, and stored MTT is not merely an algebraic or quantized copy of stored CBV/CBF, leaving a stable nontrivial residual and enough three-channel edit headroom.
keystone_residual_assumption: Primary sources verify registered maps produced by icobrain cva 1.5.0, but not stored units, clipping/background semantics, or algebraic dependence. Stage 0 must inspect arrays, quantify MTT-versus-CBV/CBF dependence and quantization, test residual stability under two frozen masks, and count eligible sites by carrier and sign. Algebraic or quantization-only residual, artifact-dominated support, or inadequate inventory kills model inference.
rung_reached: 0. Rung 1 requires array, inventory, surrogate-performance, channel-reliance, set-point, realism, sham-sensitivity, and frozen interaction gates.
dies_like_prior: Ideas 037 and 038 died because acquisition or physiology co-varied with the proposed mechanism. Here the residual is set within the same site and held fixed during the evidence edit. The design still cannot identify why maps disagree or generalize beyond the tested surrogate.
closest_prior_work: Konstas et al. establish the central-volume relation; Kudo et al. show software-dependent maps from identical source data; ISP-Net demonstrates multichannel perfusion-map fusion. None of these primary works tests this within-site interaction. This is a limited-search gap, not a novelty claim.

novelty_neighbors.work: Konstas et al., Theoretic Basis and Technical Implementations of CT Perfusion in Acute Ischemic Stroke, Part 1
novelty_neighbors.relation: Defines the theorem and notes MTT calculation from CBV/CBF, creating both the invariant and trivial-residual risk.

novelty_neighbors.work: Kudo et al., Differences in CT Perfusion Maps Generated by Different Commercial Software
novelty_neighbors.relation: Shows across-software map disagreement, not within-triplet residual use by a model.

novelty_neighbors.work: Liu et al., ISP-Net: Fusing features to predict ischemic stroke infarct core on CT perfusion maps
novelty_neighbors.relation: Fuses native CTP, CBF, CBV, MTT, and Tmax without a conservation-residual intervention.

novelty_delta: The searched delta is a within-site, residual-set, identity-preserving interaction test of whether cross-map inconsistency modulates response to perfusion worsening.
why_not_done: Residuals are usually treated as quantification or software-validation issues while prediction models treat maps as input channels. The released residual may also be trivial, which Stage 0 tests rather than assumes.
verified_dataset_facts: The official Zenodo record releases NCCT, CTA, 4D CTP, and Tmax, CBF, CBV, and MTT maps; derivatives are registered to NCCT space (record 16748089; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.16731717).

The 2026 primary dataset paper reports 149 public training and 96 hidden test cases; the older challenge paper reported planned counts of 150/98, so the later realized counts govern (DOI 10.1148/ryai.250603; arXiv:2408.10966).

Reference final-infarct masks were derived from follow-up DWI acquired 2-9 days after successful reperfusion using DeepISLES followed by neuroradiologist-supervised correction (DOI 10.1148/ryai.250603).
The primary paper reports Dice and absolute lesion-volume difference as official task metrics (DOI 10.1148/ryai.250603).
The public release is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and distributed as one approximately 99 GB train.7z archive in the inspected record (Zenodo record 16748089).
existing_assets: ISLES'24 provides registered perfusion maps, raw CTP, and final masks for 149 public training cases. Existing annotations add no new annotation burden. No verified released winner checkpoint is available, so the scoped object is one frozen self-trained surrogate.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Download and inspect the approximately 99 GB release. On a frozen audit subset test algebraic dependence, quantization, support, residual stability, and eligible-site inventory before training. If those pass, freeze patient-level development and untouched evaluation splits; train one multichannel surrogate and require prespecified held-out performance plus reliance on at least two linked maps. On untouched cases run both role-disjoint 2x2 constructions. Verify signed-r set-points voxelwise, forbid r=0 crossing, gate every complete cell by a frozen multichannel realism metric, and estimate the preregistered within-site difference-in-differences with compensator-only, zero-dose, and off-site shams. Freeze counts, doses, tolerances, statistic, decision rule, and power before edited inference. No new annotation is required.
standing_confounds_addressed: Within-site factorials hold anatomy and receptive-field context fixed. Role swaps separate residual carrier from evidence compensator. Exact signed-r verification prevents factor leakage. Opposite sign strata reverse raw carrier motion while preserving the X prediction. Full-cell realism gates address joint-edit shift; compensator-only shams measure direct compensator response. These controls establish functional behavior only on tested support.
alternative_explanations: A raw CBV- or MTT-conditioned nonlinearity could mimic one arm; swapped roles and opposite signs are required, though input-output tests cannot assign an internal semantic computation.
The compensator itself changes prediction; its coordinate-matched sham is measured and the interaction must survive the frozen sham adjustment.
Joint cells may be off distribution; every complete cell must pass frozen feature-distance and range/clipping gates.
X may be rounding, support, or clipping structure; Stage 0 kills inference if dependence and artifact audits show that.
anticipated_negative: A null is meaningful only after powered inventory, surrogate performance, reliance on two linked maps, exact set-point preservation, realistic cells, and detectable sham sensitivity. It then rejects functional residual-dependent modulation for this surrogate, dose, and support. If the residual is algebraically trivial, inference dies but the dependence result remains a useful dataset-composition finding.

cross_domain.borrowed_construct: Conservation-law residuals from process control, where redundant measurements linked by a balance equation can flag unreliable measurements.
cross_domain.measurement_it_implies: The signed log residual of CBV = CBF x MTT and a crossed test of whether setting its magnitude changes response to an r-preserving evidence edit.
cross_domain.what_changes_if_dropped: Without the residual, this becomes generic channel perturbation and no longer asks whether physical inconsistency modulates trust.

remaining_legwork: Provision storage for 99 GB; audit array semantics; freeze laterality, masks, algebra, quantization, and inventory rules; independently review all factorial cells; specify complete-cell realism; establish surrogate performance and channel reliance; and power and freeze the interaction before inference.
entry_point_2_requirements: Measurement is signed central-volume residual. Confused artifacts are algebraic derivation, quantization, invalid support, clipping, direct carrier/compensator response, and off-distribution edits; each has a pre-model or confirmatory gate.

clarity.why: One interaction and one within-site estimand are explicit, although compensation is algebraically involved.

identifiability.why: Within-site setting, role swaps, signs, and shams address named alternatives, but the final design needs independent review and cannot prove internal computation.

medical_relevance.why: Residual-dependent trust could affect robustness across perfusion quantification, but evidence is limited to one surrogate.

interest.why: A model using physical disagreement as a reliability cue would be notable; a trivial-residual result is also informative.

prior_legwork.why: Invariant, maps, masks, and neighbors exist, but the factorial and surrogate require substantial validation.

feasibility.why: The 99 GB acquisition, uninspected residual, three-channel headroom, surrogate, and edit inventory create credible kill surfaces.

data_readiness.why: Research-only data are public but monolithic and voxel semantics need inspection.

evaluation_readiness.why: The estimand and gates are named, but doses, tolerances, counts, power, realism metric, and decision rule remain to freeze.

negative_result_value.why: A gated null rejects the scoped behavior; a trivial residual yields a standalone dataset-quality result.

novelty_confidence.why: Targeted primary-source search found no direct test, but absence was not systematic and the keystone is uninspected.

regret.why: Redundant maps make the audit natural, though confirmation is no longer cheap.

unverified_claims: released values permit a stable nontrivial residual
stored MTT is not an algebraic or quantized derivative
enough sites have three-channel headroom in both carrier-by-sign cells
a surrogate passes performance and two-channel-reliance gates
joint cells pass a frozen realism gate
the factorial excludes practically plausible residual-blind counterexamples
the literature gap survives systematic review
plain_pitch: ISLES'24 provides three blood-flow maps tied by a physical equation, but the released voxel values may not obey it exactly. This study first checks whether disagreement is real rather than rounding or support artifact. If it is, the study asks whether a stroke surrogate reacts less to the same physically consistent worsening when disagreement is experimentally raised at the same tissue site. A gated null rules out that behavior for the tested model; a trivial residual instead documents an important benchmark property.
